title: Required sections go unenforced by lore check for every existing type: measure the fleet impact of closing it and report (OPAG-425 R3, separate task)
description: Binding record: opum-doc main 7831fff, docs/adr/add-constitution-and-constants-document-types-to-lore.md, R3: 'The broader gap, required sections going unenforced by check for every existing type, is explicitly out of scope here: lore-cli files it separately, measures the fleet impact of closing it, and reports back.' lore check fully parses only files carrying tasks: (check.ts ~478-490); only lore validate enforces required sections and fields. Measure, by ref across the fleet repositories that carry a lore bundle, how many documents would fail if check enforced validate's rules, report the counts per repository (and how many repositories and documents were read) to opum-agent as a design input, and do not change check's behaviour for existing types under this task.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A per-repository count of documents that would newly fail, with the number of repositories and documents read, is reported to opum-agent
The measurement method is recorded on this task so it can be re-run

implementationNotes: MEASUREMENT 2026-09-26 (lore from source at lore-cli origin/dev c956cca6, lore 0.9.3, quest 0.10.0, bun 1.3.14). READ: 10 of 10 fleet repos by ref (origin/dev of opum-agent 5ca28e7a, opum-doc c97d1908, lore-cli c956cca6, quest-cli 45b5a4e1, opum-cli-e2e a73c66ea, lore-web ce2c0dcb, quest-web d7da8457, opum-web 7eab1564, opum-marketplace 8e5eec20, opum-fleet e13b9cdb); 10 bundles; 384 documents (328 concepts, 56 without frontmatter that validate skips); 129 of a type with required sections (75 ADR, 54 Story). lore errored in none, so each zero is a real zero; validate and check walked the same file set in every repo. RESULT: 1 document would newly fail, on a required SECTION: opum-doc docs/stories/chart-a-graph-primitives-roadmap-for-agentic-engineering.md (Story, no '## Acceptance criteria'). 0 would newly fail on a required FIELD. Per repo newly failing: opum-doc 1, every other repo 0. POSITIVE CONTROLS in the same pass: an ADR missing '## Consequences' and a frontmatter file with no type were flagged by validate and not by check (check exit 0); a profile-required 'owner' missing on a Reference was flagged by validate only; the same file carrying 'tasks: []' made check exit 6 (complete:false, the first error only, on stderr). DESIGN-RELEVANT: (1) check never enforces required sections, even on files it fully parses: the one hit carries tasks: [odoc-191, odoc-192] and check is silent; the tasks: carve-out only governs required FIELDS. (2) Field exposure is small by construction: every fleet .lore/profile.toml is the fully commented template and lore-cli has none, so the built-in profile's only required field is type; a repo declaring a required field later changes this count. METHOD (re-runnable): per repo, git -C <repo> fetch; git archive origin/dev into scratch; git init + commit a snapshot there (check needs git, and without it stops at quest in 8 of 10 repos); symlink lore-cli node_modules into the by-ref lore-cli extract; run 'bun run <extract>/src/cli.ts validate --json' and 'check --json' in each; count validate files with a rule=='required-section' finding, or a frontmatter error 'is missing a `type`' / 'received undefined', whose path check does not name; also read check's stderr, where a tasks:-file field error surfaces as a throw rather than a finding. Include the two control bundles in the same loop.
finalSummary: Measured, changed nothing: had lore check enforced validate's required sections and fields on 2026-09-26, 1 document fleet-wide would newly fail (opum-doc docs/stories/chart-a-graph-primitives-roadmap-for-agentic-engineering.md, a Story missing '## Acceptance criteria'); 0 on a required field. 10 of 10 repos and 384 documents were read by ref at origin/dev, with lore from source at c956cca6, positive controls in the same pass. Also found: check never enforces required sections even on files it fully parses (the tasks: carve-out only governs fields), and every fleet profile is the commented template, so 'type' is the only required field. Per-repository counts, repos and documents read, and the design facts were reported to opum-agent by cross-session message on 2026-09-26 (AC1). The re-runnable method is in this task's notes (AC2). check's behaviour for existing types is unchanged.
